closure_definition: auxiliary feedback reset prototype: trigger=user clicks download/support feedback and reset controls; core behavior=increment, clear, and refresh-reset local counters; observable result=local feedback state is visible and never implies production integration
trigger: user clicks download or support entry, then clicks the matching local clear control or refreshes the prototype page
core_behavior: increment and clear local download/support feedback counters in the static prototype without persistence or external integration
observable_result: download and support feedback counts are visible, resettable, and returned to default state after refresh

acceptance_criteria.description: 用户重复点击客户端下载入口后，可以通过本地控件清零下载反馈次数。
acceptance_criteria.example_input: 用户点击客户端下载入口两次，再点击下载反馈清零控件
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: 下载状态先显示反馈 2 次，再回到默认或 0 次的本地反馈状态，并继续明确 not_integrated。
acceptance_criteria.boundary_case: 清零后再次点击下载入口从 1 次重新累计，不触发真实下载或外部跳转。
acceptance_criteria.failure_mode: 反馈无法清零、计数错乱，或触发真实下载/外部跳转。
acceptance_criteria.backend_capability: real client download is not integrated

acceptance_criteria.description: 用户重复点击联系客服入口后，可以通过本地控件清零客服反馈次数。
acceptance_criteria.example_input: 用户点击联系客服入口两次，再点击客服反馈清零控件
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: 客服状态先显示反馈 2 次，再回到默认或 0 次的本地反馈状态，并继续明确 not_integrated。
acceptance_criteria.boundary_case: 清零后再次点击客服入口从 1 次重新累计，不触发真实客服系统。
acceptance_criteria.failure_mode: 反馈无法清零、计数错乱，或触发真实客服系统。
acceptance_criteria.backend_capability: real support system is not integrated

acceptance_criteria.description: 用户刷新原型页面后，下载和客服反馈回到默认安全状态。
acceptance_criteria.example_input: 用户点击下载和客服入口后刷新页面
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: 页面刷新后下载和客服状态回到等待操作或 0 次反馈，不保留上次计数。
acceptance_criteria.boundary_case: 刷新后立即点击任一入口，计数从 1 次开始。
acceptance_criteria.failure_mode: 刷新后仍保留旧计数，或依赖持久化存储。
acceptance_criteria.backend_capability: no persistent storage or backend state is integrated

exclusions: UNIT-1 does not implement real client download, support integration, backend calls, telemetry, auth, deployment, release, or rollback
UNIT-1 does not create or modify phase-1 user-decision.json
priority_basis: UNIT-1 is the only phase-2 unit and proves whether the clean-room chain can run a small real prototype increment

protected_behaviors: the prototype must not perform real client download, real support integration, backend calls, telemetry, auth, release, rollback, or persistent storage
phase-1 signoff state and user decision boundary must remain untouched
business_constraints: UNIT-1 remains a local static prototype increment
QA evidence must come from a real browser over the local prototype

verification_plan.business_operation: click download and support entries repeatedly, clear each counter, refresh the prototype, and inspect visible state
verification_plan.expected_observation: each AC has visible local feedback and every backend-facing action remains prototype_only or not_integrated
verification_plan.evidence_target: desktop and mobile browser interaction record plus screenshots

options: dedicated clear buttons near each auxiliary status
single shared reset control for both auxiliary statuses
design_decision_candidates.constraints: must remain local, obvious in desktop/mobile browsers, and not introduce persistence or external integration
design_decision_candidates.design_handoff: choose local reset controls and verification boundaries
